steps.name: blow-up-actual-pixels
steps.eval: (() => { const c = [...document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay canvas')].find((x) => !!x.getContext('2d')); const img = document.createElement('img'); img.src = c.toDataURL('image/png'); img.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;width:100vw;height:100vh;object-fit:contain;background:#000;image-rendering:pixelated'; document.body.appendChild(img) })()
